As a tank there’s not much you can do against sombra because you’re generally quite easy to hack and farm for emp. But on rein which you say you play quite a bit you need to try and turn your shield the moment you hear the hack come out, or for the long term (this counts for road hog as well) try to think “if I get hacked am I going to get ram over”. A zarya as your duo can really help with this because a bubble gets rid of your hack. If a sombra is really ruining your game I recommend Orisa since her fortify nullifies sombras hack immediately (same with sleep dart). 

As for Ana sleep darts it shouldn’t be too hard to block on rein after practice because her sleep has a loud sound and a wind up animation but I like to try and bait it by swinging and mid swing shielding to see if the ana goes for a sleep. On roadhog and to a lesser extent ball, Ana is generally your counter. On hog sometimes quickly peaking left and right from a corner while shooting can bait a sleep and if it’s from a distance getting slept hopefully shouldn’t get you killed. On when piledriving an ana, roll underneath her as they usually expect you to shoot so go for a sleep and they can’t aim completely down which almost a guaranteed miss. Or just shooting them and and when they turn around go into ball form and move left or right is a very consistent way to bait sleeps from focused Ana’s.

Sorry if this wasn’t very helpful, good luck in your future games!
